description: Ticket counts per built-in status (New, Processing assigned/planned, Pending, Solved, Closed), other_status_count for codes outside 1–6, and the total, without listing the tickets. Report other statuses separately and check counts_consistent before reporting an exact breakdown. For open tickets only, filter status (field 12) equals 'notold'; unfiltered counts include solved and closed tickets. Optional criteria narrow the scope, e.g. one entity: [{field: 80, searchtype: 'equals', value: <entity id>}] (Ticket search option IDs: 80 = entity, 4 = requester, 5 = technician, 7 = category; same criteria shape as glpi_search).

criteria.description: Optional criteria to narrow the scope: array of {field, searchtype, value, link}

name: glpi_get_ticket_stats
title: Get ticket stats
